seoTitle: Paper Sizes: A4, Letter and More in mm, Inches and Pixels
metaDescription: Look up A, B, C and US paper sizes in mm, inches, points and pixels at your DPI. Free reference.
intro: Shows ISO A, B and C sizes, DL and US sizes such as Letter, Legal and Tabloid in millimetres, inches, points and pixels at a chosen DPI.
why:
Printing, PDF and design work need the exact page size. A4 is 210 x 297 mm and US Letter is 8.5 x 11 inches, which are not the same shape.

Pick a size to see it in every unit, including pixels at 72, 150 or 300 DPI. The ISO sizes follow the published millimetre values; the ISO text itself was not checked.
howTo: Choose a paper size or All sizes.
Read the sizes in mm, inches, points and pixels.

faq.a: 2480 x 3508 px at 300 DPI, 595 x 842 at 72 DPI.

faq.q: Why is Letter different from A4?
faq.a: They come from different standards. Letter is a little wider and shorter.
Sizes are portrait, width first. Swap them for landscape.
